title: Ing E Asahan a Pamangan ning Matua
intro: King sagradung lugal ning Bale ning Allah, metung a matwang talasuyu ning Dios ing menakit king metung a malalam a misteryu a e na agyung asahan. Iting debotong indibidwal, milabas na ing banua ning natural a pangamatua, menakit yang bage a pambihira a pepakit king alang kapupusan a lunus ning Divino. Ing puzzle atiu keng pamagbuklat kening mekalingwan a penandit ibat keng bie da reng propeta.
clues: Kilala la ding memalen ku bilang Israel, lahi na ning metung a dakilang patriarka kanitang minunang panaun.
Gagamitan ku ing bengi ku king pamanalangin, siklaud king arapan ning Ginu ku king templo.
Mirinan kung anak a lalaki keng kanakung pangamatua, metung a regalu na eku tinuknang parangalan i Allah.
Ing kanakung pamanyubuk metung yang pamagdiskubri keng sustentu na linwal para keng metung a kayanakan a kaladwa lalam ning kanakung pamaningat.
Metung kung propeta a milagyuan Zakariyya, a mipagkalub king pamag-alaga kang Maryam king Bayt al-Maqdis.
Ing pakibat atyu ya keng bersikulo nung nukarin tinggap ne ning Allah i Maryam at dininan neng pamangan.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
